core.title: Declare the URN side segment as frontend or backend by real ownership
core.given: A file in a repository governed by this stack's realization carries a traceability URN of the profile's full component-URN shape; in a stack-spanning repository (one language and one runtime serving both halves) the side cannot be inferred from language or runtime.
core.when: The URN is present or is written/edited, or the file's implementation changes which side owns it.
core.then: The side segment of the traceability URN must be exactly `frontend` for browser-owned implementation or `backend` for server-owned implementation.
prefer: During GREEN repair, derive side from where responsibility lives, not merely from file syntax.
Treat server-rendered fragments as backend and browser-resident behavior as frontend.
When the rest of the URN is correct, change only the side segment.
avoid: Moving implementation between client and server just to fix a header.
Using the runtime declaration as a substitute for the side decision.
unless: URNs that are not of the profile's full component-URN shape (which carries the side segment) are skipped by this check.
The runtime declaration is a different axis — a `backend` module may declare an isomorphic (client-shared) runtime.
core.why: In a stack-spanning repository one language and one runtime serve both halves, so the side segment alone says which side a module belongs to and must be declared per file (unlike single-side stacks, frontend or backend by construction, where it is near-redundant).
evidence: The stack's traceability check reports no finding for the side segment.
Reviewer confirms the side segment matches the implementation's real ownership (browser-owned → frontend, server-owned → backend).
verification: Check the side segment of the traceability URN (position and shape from the profile's component-URN shape) against the closed vocabulary {`frontend`, `backend`}; the closed vocabulary is shared across realizations of this obligation, not chosen per stack.
Only evaluate URNs of the profile's full component-URN shape; URNs of any other shape or segment count are skipped by this check.
Do not read the runtime declaration for this check: the runtime axis neither triggers nor waives the side/ownership obligation; a `backend` module with an isomorphic runtime declaration is valid.
Severity 3; disposition strict — the check fails on every finding.

values: file in a repository governed by this stack's convention realization
file carrying a traceability URN in the profile's full component-URN shape (the shape that carries the side segment)
the declared side-segment value vs the module's real ownership (browser-owned vs server-owned)

fires: A file of this realization is written with a traceability URN of the full component-URN shape (carrying a side segment).
An existing URN of that shape (touched or not) has its side segment set to something other than `frontend` or `backend` (e.g. empty, `shared`, `server`).
A module that renders server-side fragments is labelled `frontend`, or browser-resident behavior is labelled `backend`.
An implementation edit moves a module's responsibility between browser and server while its URN is left unchanged.
doesNotFire: The URN is not of the full component-URN shape that carries the side segment (this check is skipped).

Only the runtime declaration differs (e.g. a `backend` file declaring an isomorphic runtime) AND the side segment is in the closed vocabulary and matches real ownership. The runtime declaration neither triggers nor waives the side obligation.
Files without a traceability URN, or repositories not using this realization (served by their own per-stack checks).

profileRequirements.meaning: The full component-URN shape carried in a file's traceability header, including the segment count and the position of the side segment; only URNs of this shape are subject to the side obligation, and the check reads the side segment at the position this shape gives.
profileRequirements.bunValue: six-segment URN header; the side segment is segment 4 (1-indexed), written `{side}`

profileRequirements.meaning: How a source or test file declares its traceability URN — the binding construct the side segment is read from.
profileRequirements.bunValue: a URN traceability header in the file ("file carrying a URN traceability header")

neutralityNotes: The closed side vocabulary {frontend, backend} and the browser-owned/server-owned ownership mapping are shared across realizations and stay in the core. The URN shape (six segments, side at segment 4) and the header binding are profile data (urn.component, urn.binding.component). The runtime-declaration axis deliberately gets no profile key: the check never reads it, so the core keeps only the neutral concept and the concrete `Runtime:` header syntax lives in bunOnly. Detector/validator/finding ids and the cross-realization provenance sentence ('unchanged from the Python and Vite realizations') are bunOnly per the vocabulary's notProfileKeys; severity and disposition stay in core:verification. activation.fires/doesNotFire were neutralized alongside the numbered items (six-segment → full component-URN shape; `Runtime: isomorphic` → isomorphic runtime declaration) and are not separately numbered.
